Cars definitely do look better than bikes, I have to agree there. But I find something about them to be a little wasteful and imperfect. A 1-seat car would be perfect for me 95% of the time, but (almost) no one makes them. Sport bikes don't have nearly as much going for them, but to me they do have a unique beauty of being so fit for their purpose. I'd have to buy a formula race car to get something that focused on 4 wheels.

It's exactly that imperfection that I love. They are wasteful and can be ungainly and heavy and slow. It's the very thing that makes them cars that limits them in terms of objective brilliance. I love that they have such a strong focus on being loud and pretty in the face of "better." It's that kind of thing that gives them personalities and makes them lovable and more than just machines.
